about: Finite-trace timed temporal logic progression and honest Idle|Cut stop semantics (PROPERTY-TESTING P3).

mutants.name: tl-eventually-pending-holds-at-idle
mutants.from: Violated{Step: lastStep, At: lastAt, Why: Trail{Label: ev.label, Detail: "never satisfied before idle end", Children: []Trail{}}}
mutants.rule: A pending Eventually at an Idle end is Violated, never Holds.

mutants.name: tl-always-pending-violated-at-cut
mutants.to: Violated{Step: lastStep, At: lastAt, Why: Trail{Label: al.label, Detail: "cut before end", Children: []Trail{}}}
mutants.rule: A pending Always at a Cut end is Open (not proved), never Violated.

mutants.name: tl-within-off-by-one-instant
mutants.rule: Within deadlines are inclusive: elapsed == d is inside the window and elapsed > d is outside.

mutants.name: tl-next-reads-current
mutants.rule: Next advances one state before evaluating its inner formula rather than reading the current state.

mutants.name: tl-then-reads-late-state
mutants.rule: Then captures the current state s and immediately evaluates Read(s) at that same step, not one step late.

mutants.name: tl-implies-negates-wrong-side
mutants.from: nOr[S]{left: nNot[S]{inner: compile[S](im.When), label: "not"}, right: compile[S](im.Then)}
mutants.to: nOr[S]{left: compile[S](im.When), right: nNot[S]{inner: compile[S](im.Then), label: "not"}}
mutants.rule: Implies(when, then) negates the antecedent (Or(Not(when), then)), never the consequent.
